name: AR-23T Liberator Talon
description: A new arsenal weapon that fires a new projectile type with a new damage type, all registered as game data: a blue-metal Liberator (weapon registry) firing a copy of the LAS-58 Talon's bolt (projectile registry) that deals five times the Talon's damage (damage registry), drawn by a blue copy of the Talon bolt's effect. Model, effects and sounds in hellforge-data.json (HellForge builds them from your game copy). Source in src/.
